decisions.reason: As an extension of the firm's established biodynamic yogurt line that remained visible through 2024, it fits core capabilities and management is likely to continue it while attributing any weak performance to normal post-launch adjustment rather than failure.

This newly launched sliced cheese is close to the firm's traditional dairy business, has already received its own product page, and recent investment plus public commitment make management likely to retain it for longer.

Because this butter cheese was only introduced in 2024, sits squarely in the firm's established cheese offer, and the firm has publicly presented it, management is likely to keep backing it instead of reversing course quickly.
